changeSet.sql: IF TYPE_ID(N'dbo.LineageTable') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TYPE [dbo].[LineageTable] AS TABLE( [ID] [int] NULL, [SourceIntersectID] [int] NULL, [SourceSubject] [varchar](50) NULL, [SourceSubjectID] [int] NULL, [SourceObject] [varchar](50) NULL, [SourceObjectID] [int] NULL, [TargetIntersectID] [int] NULL, [TargetSubject] [varchar](50) NULL, [TargetSubjectID] [int] NULL, [TargetObject] [varchar](50) NULL, [TargetObjectID] [int] NULL, [Deleting] [bit] NULL, [Adding] [bit] NULL ) END
